title: Add intake-prober and compact performance signature generator for onboarding automation
author: Aisha Raman
description: Context & motivation: onboarding teams increasingly need a fast, low-cost heuristic to decide which model variants merit deep profiling in the full benchmarking lab. Full profiles are expensive and delay release notes. This PR introduces a lightweight intake prober and a compact performance signature generator that runs at model intake time (or in a lightweight CI job) to produce a small, stable fingerprint: latency distribution percentiles for a short synthetic workload, memory watermark estimate, and a compact tokenization/seq-length histogram. These signatures are used to: 1) automatically tag models for ‘deep profile’ scheduling, 2) seed changelog entries with expected latency ranges, and 3) enable fast compatibility checks for quantized variants. What changed (high level): added an intake CLI tool (intake-prober) that takes a model URI and runs a configurable set of short probes; added perf_signature protobuf and serializer; added a registry hook that attaches the generated signature to model metadata and triggers the changelog draft generator; added a tiny delta-annotator that compares a new signature against the previous model version and emits a concise human-readable blurb for release notes. Design notes: signatures are intentionally compact (<= 12 KB JSON when base64-encoded) and stable across probe runs by using deterministic synthetic seeds and a fixed micro-workload template; the prober is conservative about network calls and supports both local and s3-like URIs. The metadata contract extends the onboard manifest with perf_signature.v1 and a signed provenance checksum for tenanted audit. Security: prober runs in a sandboxed container by default; it intentionally avoids executing user-provided code. Backwards compatibility: metadata additions are additive; the registry continues to accept older manifests without signatures. Testing & validation: unit tests for serializer/roundtrip, CI integration test that runs the prober against a tiny distilled test model, and a staging rollout for the registry hook with feature-flag gating. Checklist: - [x] CLI prober implementation - [x] perf_signature proto and schema docs - [x] registry hook and changelog piccolo annotator - [x] unit and integration tests - [x] feature flag + rollout plan - [x] end-to-end manual verification in staging Deploy plan: merge behind feature flag; enable prober for a small cohort of onboarding runs this quarter; monitor churn and false-positive deep-profile tags for two weeks. Impact: expected to reduce full-profile churn by surfacing only ~30% of incoming models for deep profiling while adding actionable latency guidance to changelogs for ~65% of model rollouts. See linked Linear tasks. Merge notes: addressed reviewer requests to reduce noisy logging, shrink serialized blob size, and add deterministic RNG seeding for the micro-workload. CI: initial lint run failed on an import ordering; fixed and re-ran; full pipeline (unit/integration/e2e) passed. Merge method: squash. For reviewers: see the commits summary and file list below for quick context.

review_comments: Marco Chen: Can we reduce the default probe duration from 30s to 10s for CI runs? Reason: CI quota. Author: lowered default and added --duration override; added explicit note in docs.
Lena Ortiz: The serialized signature is still large when token histograms are dense. Suggested bucketing. Author: switched to fixed 8-bucket histogram and added compression step to serializer.
Priya Kapoor: Please add provenance signature field and make the hook idempotent. Author: added provenance checksum, idempotency guard, and extra unit tests.
Marco Chen: Nit: log lines should be structured JSON for parsing in Console. Author: changed logs to JSON and added structured logging helper.
Lena Ortiz: CI flake observed on e2e with ephemeral registry credentials. Author: tweaked e2e to use pre-seeded test credentials and retry logic.
Priya Kapoor (approval): LGTM once CI passes and the feature flag gating is documented in rollout plan.
release_notes:
- Added 'intake-prober' CLI: fast heuristics to produce compact performance signatures at model intake.
- perf_signature.v1: compact latency/memory/tokenization fingerprint attached to model metadata.
- Registry hook: auto-attaches signatures and seeds changelog drafts with latency guidance.
- Added unit/integration tests and staging rollout behind feature flag.
notes_for_release_manager: Feature is behind 'intake-prober' flag. Rollout recommended: enable for 5% of onboarding traffic for 2 weeks, monitor 'deep_profile_tag_rate' and 'signature_variance' metrics. If deep_profile_tag_rate < 20% increase probe duration; if signature_variance > 12% investigate synthetic workload stability.
